messages:
Tom (AE): quick thread  Meridian Health renewal - they want to convert monthly retainer + overage into an annual commit, pushing for a 20% off list headline. also asking for data residency (EU) and an option to move to Dedicated in Q3.
Priya (Sales Eng): FYI the Dedicated path requires KMS + subnet config; that adds ops time but we can stage it. For the POC they want an extended 45-day trial with dedicated nodes - that's expensive. recommend 14-day dedicated trial + 31-day shared burst.
Aisha (AM): their usage spiked during last quarter due to a pilot. risk: they've had a billing dispute earlier this year; we should keep onboarding credit to offset that.
Connor (Deal Desk): 20% on the proposed commit size (~$200k ARR) is beyond our standard band. Options: 1) 12% commit discount + $15k onboarding credit; 2) 18% discount if they sign 24m and prepay 6m; 3) approve 20% only with exec sign-off + proof of larger TAM. which path is preferred?
Tom (AE): customer insists on 20% but would consider 18% for 18m. they won't prepay. can we move faster if legal loops are minimal?
Sophie (Legal): need to flag the data residency clause and SLO amendment. If they want EU-only processing, that's a change to the standard DPA - will need InfoSec and privacy signoff. timeline ~5 business days.
secbot: Security questionnaire updated: Meridian Health: open items - KMS type, SOC2 subprocessor list, data residency confirmation. (link: https://redwood-sec/qa/meridian-2026)
Priya (Sales Eng): technical ask: if Dedicated is planned later, add a migration credit clause so cost of a short dedicated POC doesn't blow the economics. propose: "Dedicated POC cap = 4 weeks; uplift billed at $3k/week; migration credit = max($6k) applied on conversion within 90 days."
Aisha (AM): good call. also suggest a 30-day SLA credit cap (e.g., credits capped at 15% of monthly invoice) to address their downtime worries without opening unlimited liability.
Connor (Deal Desk): drafting two commercial proposals: Fast Close (12% + $15k credit, 12m term) and Stretch Commit (18% + migration credit, 18m term). I'll circulate a redline template.
Tom (AE): can we include a short "POC overrun" clause: if POC > 45 days, we automatically apply a one-time 50% discount on POC dedicated uplift. keeps things predictable.
Priya (Sales Eng): engineering ok with that as long as we add a resource cap and a weekly notice for scaling. we'll add an ops playbook.
Sophie (Legal): I'll take Connor's draft and insert data residency and DPA changes. will need to loop in Privacy for the subprocessor list.
Connor (Deal Desk): FYI rate snippet used for math:
```
List gen rate: $0.020 / 1k tokens
Commit tier (100k+ / mo): standard discount band: 12%
Stretch discount band (200k+ / mo): 18%
Onboarding credit (one-time): $15,000
Dedicated POC uplift: $3,000 / week (capped)
SLA credit cap: up to 15% monthly invoice
```
Tom (AE): customer meeting tomorrow 11a. I want to present the Fast Close as the recommended path and mention Stretch as available with 18m. can someone own the numbers slide?
Aisha (AM): I'll own slide + renewal playbook notes. tagging me for close ops. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Sales Eng): I'll prepare the POC ops checklist and the migration credit language.
Sophie (Legal): will review and aim to get drafts to Connor by EOD. Privacy pinged.
Connor (Deal Desk): escalated to finance for provisional sign-off on $15k onboarding credit and 12% band. dealbot: Connor escalated deal 2070111111 to finance-review queue (priority: medium)
Tom (AE): thanks all. will brief customer after we have the contract draft.
